.AVIATION...

Cold and dry light northerly flow today will lead to mostly clear 
skies, though some narrow, transient low cloud streamers remain 
possible this morning. Light and variable winds and clear skies this 
evening gives way to light northeast-east flow overnight. This will 
promote the development of low clouds and borderline MVFR/VFR cigs 
over southern tafs (yip/dtw/det/ptk) late tonight, as moisture works 
of Lake Erie. Confidence is lower at FNT/MBS, but low 
clouds/moisture from southern Lake Huron may come into play as well.
